import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

d = np.genfromtxt('/app/spectrum.csv', delimiter=',', names=True)
x = d['raman_shift_cm1']; y = d['intensity']

def lor(x, amp, x0, g, off):
    return amp*g*g/((x-x0)**2+g*g)+off

def fit(lo, hi, p0):
    m = (x>=lo)&(x<=hi)
    xs, ys = x[m], y[m]
    p, cov = curve_fit(lor, xs, ys, p0=p0, maxfev=200000)
    resid = ys - lor(xs, *p)
    ss = float(np.sum(resid**2))
    return p, np.sqrt(ss/len(xs)), len(xs)

print('--- D individual windows ---')
for lo, hi in [(1150,1500),(1200,1470),(1250,1450),(1150,1480),(1100,1500)]:
    p, r, n = fit(lo, hi, [800,1350,20,800])
    print(f'[{lo},{hi}] n={n} x0={p[1]:.3f} gamma={p[2]:.3f} amp={p[0]:.3f} off={p[3]:.3f} rms={r:.2f}')

print('--- G individual windows ---')
for lo, hi in [(1450,1720),(1470,1700),(1500,1680),(1480,1750),(1420,1760)]:
    p, r, n = fit(lo, hi, [6600,1580,25,800])
    print(f'[{lo},{hi}] n={n} x0={p[1]:.3f} gamma={p[2]:.3f} amp={p[0]:.3f} off={p[3]:.3f} rms={r:.2f}')

print('--- 2D individual windows ---')
for lo, hi in [(2500,2900),(2550,2850),(2520,2880),(2580,2820),(2450,2950)]:
    p, r, n = fit(lo, hi, [9500,2690,30,900])
    print(f'[{lo},{hi}] n={n} x0={p[1]:.3f} gamma={p[2]:.3f} amp={p[0]:.3f} off={p[3]:.3f} rms={r:.2f}')

print('--- global fit 3 Lorentzians + one offset ---')
def model3(x, a1,x1,g1, a2,x2,g2, a3,x3,g3, off):
    return (a1*g1*g1/((x-x1)**2+g1*g1) + a2*g2*g2/((x-x2)**2+g2*g2)
            + a3*g3*g3/((x-x3)**2+g3*g3) + off)
p0 = [800,1350,20, 6600,1580,25, 9500,2690,30, 800]
p, cov = curve_fit(model3, x, y, p0=p0, maxfev=500000)
print('params', np.round(p,4))
resid = y - model3(x, *p)
print('global rms', float(np.sqrt(np.mean(resid**2))))
